scope.engine: Actual shell-free Journey Board,MoveBudget policy6,Eco121,CompanionBattle v124 and native ability effects; native pure RankCopyRules124 and CompanionProgression reused.
scope.primary: Fresh modeled save: XP0,rank floor1,owned Nova one copy; immediate cause,U1 coach,earned Focus and dead-end warning; captured team/levels on each attempt.
scope.experimental: One-use capacity with same owned Nova and rank rewards; manual no-activation with same progression; separately loaned nova/hoot/orbit trio,only its captain gains rank copies. No ownership acquisition or team-switch policy is modeled.
scope.rankCopies: First clear uses native stars-to-XP and rank rules; each rank awards one copy to captured captain,MAX92 then45 Coins; existing board cannot award twice. Copies change only future attempt capacities.
scope.energy: All four cohorts retain existing energy policy:new starts afterU10 cost1;refill1per10modeledminutes;retries are new starts;no unlimited-energy condition.
scope.terminalClassification: After each action:solved,budget exhausted,give-up,administrative attempt cap,then availability/utility/day cap.Positive-budget open attempt alone is horizon-censored.
scope.cueAssumption: Displayed cause recognized with certainty while exposed;structured pieces/keys/relations already identified.No visual comprehension or initial learning bonus.
scope.solverBoundary: Bounded policy has no solver.Only explicit native help/talent activation exposes certified information;separate oracle controls never enter policy search.
scope.timingLimit: Legacy duration and utility formulas remain uncalibrated.Skills consume decision time including refusals.No new motivation bonus for rank/copy rewards is assumed.
scope.episodicMemory: Agent124 scopes rejected skills,remembered blocked pieces and consecutive-block pressure to the actual board identity plus visible geometry.Retries of the same board retain memories;learned rules,fatigue,frustration and global decision counts transfer.No causal 1.23-to-1.24 release claim:both model and mechanics differ.
exclusions: No rendering,perception,motor behavior,emotion,fun,comprehension or human retention measurement
No Android persistence,migration,transaction-failure or UI test;in-memory fresh-save reward adapter only
No decoration,equipment,stock powers,ads,real purchases,social or user acquisition model
No ownership acquisition,random summons,roster optimization or preexisting save distribution
Transfer policies continue feedback during probes;different campaign exposure retained,not a pure isolated-learning effect
